summary: The creator reviews the selectable legendary summons banner featuring Tariz while considering the upcoming release of Child of Chaos. Tariz is strongly recommended for players on competitive servers to secure high seasonal performance, ideally aiming for Inspiration 2. For players on less competitive servers, the creator advises saving Heliolite Dice for Child of Chaos, who acts as a top-tier universal support hero. The creator performs 300 summons on the Tariz banner, obtaining five legendary heroes (Gillian, Eurion, Nissa, Orfenna, and Victor) but deeming the session unlucky due to a lack of premium top-tier pulls.
